betterquesting:10.desc:8: §3Steam can come from the Large Geothermal Steam Boiler or the Large Solar Overpressure Array. The Gear Steam Compressor converts regular steam into a smaller amount of superheated steam and distilled water. Geothermal production requires lava and water; daylight and clear weather drive solar heat gain, while stored heat can sustain production temporarily at night or during rain.§r
